text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (April 7, 2025) for 137 Dunn Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (April 7, 2025) for 137 Dunn Avenue, Folder Number 25 140663 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted and extension of time to March 31, 2026.
